TC-19/S19.detail: Reproduced in 3 runs (no spec change after review). Device B (Honolulu, clock = server - 2 days) Save & Extract 'Hold lisinopril, BP soft.' (hold answered at the socket): stored changeDate 'Oct 11', row updatedAt and medicationsUpdatedAt 2026-10-12T07:02 (server 2026-10-14T07:02). B's screenshot 'Held · Oct 11' was taken before the server lifecycle ran; once it ran (AppLayout ContextLifecycle: whenever a page enters the Hospital section on any device, then every 10 min) it deleted the held row against its 2-day-old stamp: server medications [] and A's Medication Tracker 'No medications recorded.' Recorded only (gated TFA-94699, U20): the resident's visit date stored as B's day 'Sun Oct 11 2026'.
TC-19/S19.productIssue: A physician on a phone/laptop whose date is two days behind dictates 'Hold lisinopril, BP soft.' and taps Save & Extract: the hold is stamped 'Held · Oct 11' and, the next time the server lifecycle runs (any device entering the Hospital section, or the 10-minute timer), the lisinopril row is deleted: the Medication Tracker shows 'No medications recorded.' on every device. The tracker stamps (mergeMedEventsIntoList / useMedicationEventExtraction) use the device clock (new Date() / Date.now()). Breaks UAT 3.8 / U23 (server time; a wrong-clock device shows the same state) and TC-19 U1 (holds stay visible as open loops with their date).
